parentQA.q: Is this allowed for a high schooler?
parentQA.a: Yes. Since April 2026, NCAA rules let recruits sign with an agent before they enroll and keep their eligibility. In Indiana, the IHSAA has allowed "personal branding" deals since May 2026: no school name, logo, uniform or facilities, nothing in gambling, alcohol, tobacco, cannabis or weapons, and the athletic director told in writing within 48 hours. Indiana has no state NIL law for high schoolers; it does require any agent he signs with to be registered with the Attorney General, and gives him 14 days to cancel that agreement.
Nothing up front. The fee is written into the agreement before anything is signed, and we walk you through it in person.
Ryan Hays, a licensed attorney and NFL contract advisor since 2012. Every agreement, every time, before Jeremiah signs.

JB Sports has represented NFL players since 1986, including offensive linemen Connor Colby (49ers) and Charlie Heck (Dolphins). Six clients have become the highest paid at their position. Jack Tabb played at North Carolina and coached at Michigan State, so he knows how a college staff develops a lineman.
